users.noUsersBody: Invite the people who work with you. Each gets their own sign-in and exactly the access you choose.

users.accessFootnote: The role is the starting point; changes here are stored as differences from it, so a later role change still counts.
users.deleteDescription: This cannot be undone and makes past changes harder to attribute. Deactivating is usually better; delete only accounts created by mistake. The last active owner cannot be deleted.

users.activeHint: A disabled account cannot sign in. Nothing is deleted.
users.description: Staff accounts and what each of them can do.
users.rulesBody: Nobody can change their own role or access, or act on an equal or higher role (owners can manage each other). The last active owner cannot be demoted, disabled or deleted. Platform accounts are created from the server console only.
users.usernameImmutable: Usernames cannot be changed because the audit trail is written against them.
users.usernameHint: Letters, digits, dot, underscore and hyphen.

users.phoneFromSearch: Same as the number you searched for.
users.sentByPhone: No email on file, so nothing was sent. Send them the link below yourself; they sign in by phone.
users.foundAccountByPhone: {name} already has a Suliko account and the number matches. You'll get a link to send them; they keep their password.

invoiceTemplate.title: Your own invoice
invoiceTemplate.intro: Upload one of your real invoices as a Word file (.docx) and write '{{placeholders}}' where the order's details go, for example '{{client}}' and '{{total}}'. Office fills them in and returns Word. Your logo, stamp and layout stay as you drew them; leave them out of the file if you do not use them.
invoiceTemplate.none: No file uploaded: invoices use the standard Suliko Office layout.
invoiceTemplate.saved: Saved. Download a sample to check it.
invoiceTemplate.unknown: Not recognised, these print as nothing: {names}
invoiceTemplate.howTo: Write '{{name}}' anywhere in the file, headers and footers included. In a table, put '{{item.description}}', '{{item.languages}}', '{{item.quantity}}', '{{item.unit_price}}' and '{{item.amount}}' in one row: it repeats per document. Without a table, a line with only '{{items}}' lists them.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Organisation, pricing and reference data. Changes apply to new orders only.

general.saved: Saved. New quotes use these values; existing orders are unchanged.
general.organisationNameHint: Shown in the app and in emails your team receives.
general.timezoneHint: Decides what "today" is: default dates, what is overdue, which month a payment counts in.
general.defaultLanguageHint: The language new documents default to.
general.systemEmailHint: The From address on client notifications.
general.pricingHint: Defaults for new orders. Existing orders are not repriced.
general.dueDaysHint: Pre-fills the due date on a new order. Still editable per order.
general.courierFeeHint: Added once per order when handover is courier delivery. Passed through, not counted as profit.
general.translatorShareHint: The translator's default share of a document, unless they have their own per-page rate. Can be changed per document.
general.pricingUnitHint: New orders are priced by pages or by characters (with spaces). Each order can switch. Notary fees always follow pages.
general.charactersPerPageHint: Used when an order is calculated by characters. 1800 is the common standard page.

plan.intro: Your plan decides which sections and integrations you have. A change applies to everyone immediately.
plan.bureauLocked: A bureau stays on the Bureau plan. For your own freelance work, switch to your personal account from the organisation menu at the top.
plan.bureauIsFinal: Moving to Bureau can't be undone: a bureau can't switch back to Freelancer.
plan.personalLocked: Your personal account stays on the Freelancer plan. For a team, create a bureau from the account switcher.

companies.nameKaHint: As registered. This is the name on the invoice.

integrations.none: Nothing to connect on your plan. Order files are stored for you.
